'''''The Private Journals of Mace Windu''''' were a series of journals by Mace Windu,<ref name=":0">[[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']]</ref> later released by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] propaganda architects in the aftermath of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]].

==History==
The purpose of the ''Journals'' was to record for review Windu's thoughts and deeds during his mission to Haruun Kal,<ref name=":0" /> and later edited to convince the general public that the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] had been plotting to conquer the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. To make their fabrications more believable, the propagandists included actual recordings of [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]. The ''Journals'' included a section about Master Windu's visit to [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]] and his interaction with the [[Korun/Legends|Korunnai]]. The Imperial propaganda machine used the falsified document to provoke [[Anti-Jedi sentiment/Legends|anti-Jedi sentiment]] in the citizens of the Empire.

The document was recorded on a device that Windu didn’t know the codes to other than to add information. This was a standard practice so only the Jedi archival staff could get into the data and so he wouldn’t be tempted to go back and edit his notes to make himself look good, though when questioned on the point he stated he hoped to have the character to not be tempted even if he could.<ref name=":0" />
